name: IDEAS — Imaging Database for Epilepsy And Surgery

repo.accession: ds007401 (T1w/FLAIR shared with IDEAS II); figshare for masks, FreeSurfer, clinical tables

access.steps: Download from OpenNeuro / figshare links on cnnp-lab.com/ideas-data; no application.

cohort.age: adult surgical centre; min age at surgery 16; ages shared in 5-year bins
cohort.types: drug-resistant focal epilepsy; 356 TLE and 58 frontal resections among 433 masks
cohort.sites: 1 (UCLH / National Hospital for Neurology & Neurosurgery, London)

modalities: 3D T1w (all), 3D FLAIR (where available); 3T GE; FSPGR 0.94×0.94×1.1 mm or MPRAGE 1 mm
format: BIDS NIfTI + JSON sidecars; FreeSurfer 7.3.2 recon-all outputs; region tables (DK, Lausanne multi-scale, Destrieux, HCP-MMP1, Whittaker)
size: ds007401 is 20.5 GB in total (T1w/FLAIR for 542 subjects + DWI for 314)
labels: Resection masks from post-operative imaging for 433/442
outcomes: Annual ILAE outcome up to 5 years: 427 at 12 mo, 403 at 24 mo, 356 at 36 mo, 311 at 48 mo, 267 at 60 mo
derived: FreeSurfer surfaces/volumes; thickness, area and volume tables for several parcellations
caveats: No electrophysiology at all: no SOZ, no seizures
Resection mask is a 'silver standard' for the EZ, not ground truth
Single centre, adult resective surgery over ~20 years
Clinical table is on figshare, not in the OpenNeuro participants file (ds007401 has no participants.tsv)
checks: Cloned ds007401 git tree: dataset_description, README, file tree (542 sub- folders, 2066 anat files); read full text PMC11827737.
pipeline: Patient-specific anatomy for the virtual brain plus a surgical ground truth (mask + ILAE). With IDEAS II connectomes it supports a 'virtual resection vs outcome' test on 400+ patients without any iEEG.
key_claim: Largest open surgical-epilepsy MRI set: 442 patients with resection masks and up to 5-year ILAE outcomes, but no electrophysiology.

evidence.quote: We released MRI and demographic information from 442 individuals with epilepsy and 100 controls.
Our final data set contains pre‐operative MRI for 442 individuals, and a resection mask for 433 of those individuals
Annual ILAE surgery outcomes of up to 5 years are shared when available.
